title: RBF Kernel SVR: From Linear to Non-Linear Support Vector Regression

cues.en: -: Welcome back to your machine learning A to Zed course.
cues.zh: 歡迎回到 Machine Learning A-Z 課程。

cues.en: In this tutorial, I'd like to give you a quick heads-up about the non-linear support vector regression.
cues.zh: 這堂課想先簡單提醒你，關於非線性支援向量迴歸的安排。

cues.en: So what we discussed previously was intuition for SVR indeed, but this was intuition of the linear support vector regression model.
cues.zh: 先前討論的是 SVR 的直覺，確實如此，但那是線性支援向量迴歸模型的直覺。

cues.en: And while it's a great start into the world of SVR, it is just a start.
cues.zh: 雖然這是進入 SVR 世界很好的起點，但也只是起點。

cues.en: There is so much more to support vector regression.
cues.zh: 支援向量迴歸還有更多內容。

cues.en: This was a simple linear model.
cues.zh: 剛才只是簡單的線性模型。

cues.en: There are actually other models.
cues.zh: 實際上還有其他模型。

cues.en: And rest assured, they will be covered in this course.
cues.zh: 放心，這門課也會介紹。

cues.en: So they are coming up, and we'll be talking about, for instance, the RBF kernel SVR, and the kernel trick, and all these important things
cues.zh: 後面會談到例如 RBF 核的 SVR、核技巧，以及其他重要概念，

cues.en: that make this model even more robust.
cues.zh: 讓這個模型更強大。

cues.en: However, I wanted to give you this heads-up because already in upcoming Python tutorials that are coming right after, just following this tutorial in this section, you'll be working with Atlan
cues.zh: 不過我想先提醒你，因為接在這堂課之後、同一節裡的 Python 教學，你會和 Hadelin 一起

cues.en: to create your first SVR model, and the SVR model will already be non-linear.
cues.zh: 建立第一個 SVR 模型，而這個模型已經是非線性的。

cues.en: So here you can see the results, like I've blurred them out on purpose because I wanted not to, I wanted to make sure you don't get a spoiler by seeing the results in terms of the numbers.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到結果。我刻意將數字模糊處理，避免你提前看到數字結果而被暴雷。

cues.en: But you can see the model itself here, and you can see that it's non-linear, so just a straight line, and that is because we are using, or Atlan will be showing you
cues.zh: 但你可以看到模型本身是非線性的，不是一條直線，這是因為我們使用，或者說 Hadelin 會示範

cues.en: how to use the radial basis function, a kernel for this SVR.
cues.zh: 如何將徑向基底函數，也就是 RBF，作為這個 SVR 的核函數。

cues.en: So it's already going to be a non-linear SVR.
cues.zh: 因此它已經是非線性 SVR。

cues.en: So now what's the reason for this heads-up?
cues.zh: 為什麼要先提醒你這一點？

cues.en: Well, the thing is that the non-linear support vector regression will be covered off further down the course beyond this section.
cues.zh: 因為非線性支援向量迴歸的概念，會在這一節之後、課程更後面的部分才介紹。

cues.en: So it's a bit of a mismatch, but that's done on purpose because that's the easier way to grasp these concepts.
cues.zh: 這裡的順序稍微不一致，但這是刻意安排的，因為這樣比較容易掌握概念。

cues.en: And I'll explain in this following slide.
cues.zh: 下一張投影片會解釋。

cues.en: So this is what, this is what the non-linear SVR will look like, right?
cues.zh: 這就是非線性 SVR 看起來的樣子，對吧？

cues.en: So compared to this, this is your linear model.
cues.zh: 相比之下，這是線性模型。

cues.en: As you can see, it's much more complex over here.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，這邊複雜得多。

cues.en: We have to go into a third dimension and perform some calculations or some modeling there and go back.
cues.zh: 需要進入第三個維度，在那裡進行一些計算或建模，再回到原本空間。

cues.en: So it is quite involved.
cues.zh: 所以確實比較複雜。

cues.en: And in order to get there, the following tutorials are essential.
cues.zh: 要理解它，接下來這些教學非常重要。

cues.en: So first in the section on SVM, you'll find a tutorial called SVM Intuition.
cues.zh: 首先在 SVM 章節中，有一堂叫做 SVM Intuition 的教學。

cues.en: So that's an essential tutorial to take in the steps to getting to kernel SVR or non-linear SVR.
cues.zh: 這是通往核 SVR，也就是非線性 SVR，所必須理解的重要一步。

cues.en: Then in the section on kernel SVM, the following section, you can find them in the part of the course that is to do with classification.
cues.zh: 接著在 Kernel SVM 章節，也就是下一節；它們都位於課程的分類部分。

cues.en: So in the section on kernel SVM, there's a tutorial called Kernel SVM Intuition.
cues.zh: Kernel SVM 章節中，有一堂叫做 Kernel SVM Intuition。

cues.en: Then there's mapping to a higher dimension, the kernel trick, types of kernel function, and then finally, non-linear kernel SVR.
cues.zh: 接著是映射到更高維度、核技巧、核函數的種類，最後才是非線性核 SVR。

cues.en: So as you can see, it's quite a college topic, and it comes at the very end of this list.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這是相當複雜的主題，位於這份清單的最後。

cues.en: So from here you have two choices.
cues.zh: 因此現在有兩種選擇。

cues.en: You can either just, after this tutorial, go straight to Atlan's Python tutorials on kernel, on the SVR that are coming up and just do them,
cues.zh: 你可以在這堂課之後，直接進入接下來 Hadelin 的 Python SVR 實作，跟著做，

cues.en: and just keep in mind that he's using a nonlinear kernel.
cues.zh: 只要記得他使用的是非線性核函數。

cues.en: And that will come later in the course, the intuition for it will come later in the course.
cues.zh: 相關直覺概念，會在課程後面才介紹。

cues.en: Or if you would like to get the intuition before you do the practical side of things, then it's essential that you would need to go through all of these tutorials that are mentioned
cues.zh: 或者，如果想先理解直覺再實作，就需要先看完

cues.en: on this slide over here, get to non-linear kernel SVR, and then come back to the Python tutorials.
cues.zh: 這張投影片上列出的所有教學，一直到非線性核 SVR，再回來看 Python 教學。

cues.en: So there are two options.
cues.zh: 所以有兩個選項。

cues.en: My preference, if you ask me, I would just go for Atlan's Python tutorials.
cues.zh: 如果問我的偏好，我會直接進入 Hadelin 的 Python 教學。

cues.en: Now just keep in mind that he's using a non-linear kernel.
cues.zh: 現在先記得，他使用的是非線性核函數。

cues.en: Follow along with the code, and then you will still get the intuition when the time's right, when you get to this section on kernel SVM.
cues.zh: 跟著程式碼做，等時機到了，也就是進入 Kernel SVM 那一節時，你仍然會學到相關直覺。

cues.en: So there you go, that's just a quick heads up on what's coming up.
cues.zh: 以上就是對接下來內容的一個簡單提醒。

cues.en: Of course, the choice is yours.
cues.zh: 當然，選擇由你決定。

cues.en: And in any case, please enjoy the course, and there's lots of fun tutorials coming up.
cues.zh: 無論如何，請享受課程，後面還有許多有趣的教學。

cues.en: And I look forward to seeing you in the next one.
cues.zh: 期待在下一堂課見到你。

cues.en: Until then, happy analyzing.
cues.zh: 在那之前，分析愉快。
